name: Alejandro Covarrubias
office: City of Alhambra, Member of the City Council, Fifth District

items.text: Alejandro Covarrubias is a commercial plumber. He is a candidate for the Fifth District seat on the Alhambra City Council. In 2022 he spoke at a city council meeting in support of the city’s crossing guards. He said he would review city spending, identify non-essential items, and cut them to trim the budget. He said he would prioritize updating the city’s infrastructure and promoting skilled trades to young people as a path to financial independence. He also said the city should help families and schools prepare for future enrollment needs.
